item.title: Atlanta Slow Internet Event [resolved]
item.description:
Our Engineering team has corrected the congestion issue due to link saturation to our Atlanta market from Dallas. Traffic was migrated away from the link to resolve the packet loss and slow internet speeds our customers were experiencing.
If you are experience internet issues please submit a support request through www.tpx.com/support.

item.title: Microsoft Azure Service Issues [resolved]
item.description:

They initiated a rollback of the maintenance change request, monitored recovering telemetry and services to confirm services recovered.
If you believe your service is being impacted, please get in touch with our support team at www.tpx.com/support
